title: Krafter Template Catalog
description: catalog.json at the root of getkrafter/templates: one entry per template package under templates/<id>/. Written by scripts/update-catalog.mjs; `commit` and `previewUrl` are filled by CI on merge. Deliberately free of `format` keywords so `npx ajv-cli validate` needs no ajv-formats plugin: every constrained string carries an explicit `pattern` instead.

generatedAt.description: RFC 3339 date-time at which the catalog content last changed.

id.description: The manifest id, which is also the folder name under templates/.

author.description: The manifest's author block, passed through unchanged.

official.description: True for the ids listed in official.json, which @getkrafter/core maintains.

layout.description: The manifest's layout.mode, flattened to a string.

source.description: gh:<owner>/<repo>/templates/<id>. Derivable from the id, but stored so the app's catalog parser is uniform with the CLI dev server's catalog, which also carries `source`.

commit.description: The last commit that touched templates/<id>/ — what a resume pins.

previewUrl.description: Immutable URL of preview.png at `commit` (raw.githubusercontent.com). Absent when the package has no preview.png.
